4. Equipment
Northwind provides a home-office equipment stipend of 400 USD per year, claimable against receipts submitted through the expenses portal. Unused allowance does not roll over into the next year.

5. Reimbursement
Home-office equipment is reimbursed once every two years, up to a maximum of 750 USD. Claims must be filed within 30 days of purchase and require a manager's approval code.

6. Meetings
All-hands meetings are held on Tuesdays at 15:00. Attendance is optional for remote staff, and recordings are posted to the intranet within 24 hours.
